With Banka Bio

Wastewater Treatment

We understand the unique needs of commercial builders and industries when it comes to wastewater treatment. That's why Banka Bio provides a custom-tailored solution that will fit your specific requirements. Our sustainable approach ensures that your facility is not only compliant with environmental regulations, but also protects our planet.

Learn More

Indian Railways

We are one of the proud partners with Indian Railways in bio-toilets initiatives. Our DRDO licensed bio-toilets provide eco-friendly solutions to human waste, and minimises environmental pollution.

Learn More

Your CSR Partner

We help corporations achieve their CSR goals by offering impactful social initiatives. If you want to join us in creating a better world, take a look at our partners and see how we can help you make a positive impact on India.

Learn More

Products and Services

Our core business at Banka Bio is centered around sustainable solutions for WaSH needs. With the use of biotoilets, biodigesters, STPs (Sewage Treatment Plants) and FSTPs (Faecal Sludge Treatment Plants), we aim to create a healthier and more sustainable environment for communities and businesses alike.
